name: Sorafune
source:
The world is full of mysteries. Even though the adults laugh and think it’s just pretending to explore and chasing a childhood dream, a group of friends head out to investigate these mysteries and understand the truth behind things in this world. 

[From [URL=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/11/01/november-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau! Omochikaeri~[/url]]
translation:
世界充满了奥秘。尽管大人们笑着认为这只是假装探索和追逐儿时的梦想，一群朋友却出发去调查这些谜团，了解这个世界背后的真相。

【来自[URL=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/11/01/november-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau！Omochikaeri〜[/url]]
